content.comment_body: Is it possible to view data logs (either stored in PLC memory or on an SD card) through a mobile app or web server? Alternatively, how can data logs be accessed remotely? Regards
As far as I know, there is no method to access data logs via web servers or mobile apps. Currently, data logs can only be read using [product_name] software.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are interested in remotely accessing and reviewing data logs from their PLC units using mobile apps or web servers. The current consensus is that such remote access is not available, with access limited to using [product_name] software directly. This limitation poses challenges for users seeking more flexible data access solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users would like the ability to view or download data logs remotely via a mobile app or web server, without being restricted to direct software usage.
